eligibility_tiers.line: Students intending to enroll in college credit courses must have an unweighted high school grade point average of 3.0 or above.

Students intending to enroll in a career and technical certificate program leading to an industry certification or applied technology diploma must have an unweighted high school grade point average of 2.0 or higher.
Maintain an unweighted high school GPA of 3.0 or higher to take undergraduate-level courses and 2.0 or higher for vocational courses.
